0022600093.text: Both the Sacramento Kings and LA Clippers open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with the Kings on the road and ESPN's matchup predictor giving them a 35% chance to win. Sacramento will be without Dylan Cardwell (calf strain) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Malik Monk is day-to-day with ankle soreness and a game-time decision. The Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (foot), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while Kobe Sanders (hip) and Kris Dunn (rest) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams last met on April 5, 2026, in Sacramento, when the Kings lost 138-109, and the Kings lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3.
